items.name: script-rebuild-and-verify
items.title: Rebuild And Verify (local container)
items.description: Rebuilds a local containerized app and proves it serves: bounded health wait then a route sweep, so the exit code reflects the ROUTES rather than the build. Universal item — installs into any repo, framework-agnostic. Per-repo values live in scripts/verify.env, so the script itself stays identical everywhere.
